title: Elf Bar 600 Strawberry Raspberry Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: These Strawberry Raspberry Prefilled Pods are designed for the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, offering a fruity, mess-free way to enjoy vaping. Each pack includes two 2ml pods, each filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and capable of up to 600 puffs depending on use. With inhale activation, these pods provide a straightforward mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw that feels familiar and reliable. The flavour combines juicy, ripe Strawberry with the tangy edge of Raspberry, creating a berry blend that tastes sweet, bright, and balanced. Simple yet satisfying, it’s a flavour that’s easy to enjoy all day. When one pod is finished, replacement is quick and fuss-free — just click in a new one and continue.
